name: Canopy: Shelf & Notes
subtitle: A quiet shelf for daily work
promotionalText: Keep screenshots within reach and meeting notes simple. Write, format, and check off to-dos directly in your note.
description:
Catch it. Keep going.

Canopy keeps a quiet shelf above your work for screenshots and a movable workspace for meeting notes.

SCREENSHOTS WITHIN REACH
Hover over the menu bar and click Capture, or press Control–Option–S anywhere. Drag a region and it appears on the top shelf, ready to share. These captures stay in Canopy with no Desktop file or macOS corner preview. Drag a copy into another app, click to open Apple Preview, or discard it with ×. You can save a copy when you want to keep it.

Prefer the usual macOS screenshot shortcuts? Choose the folder where macOS saves your screenshots. Canopy copies new images into the shelf and leaves the originals there. Ordinary macOS screenshots keep the system's destination and thumbnail behavior; Canopy does not change those settings.

SIMPLE MEETING NOTES
Start listening to transcribe audio playing on your Mac, including meeting apps. Meeting audio is the default; microphone capture is optional. The transcript stays on your Mac, alongside your own notes. No audio file is saved. Write in one document with inline to-dos, headings, links and text formatting. Type / to add a block, or use the small toolbar. Focus mode gives your notes more room. Export notes and transcripts as Markdown.

QUIET BY DESIGN
Hover to reveal the small shelf, then tuck it away when you're done. Move the main workspace where it suits you and click outside to hide it. Captures, recognized text, notes and transcripts remain local. No account, advertising, tracking or developer-operated cloud library.

Language support may download on first use. Local transcription availability depends on your Mac and speech language. Capture only content you are allowed to capture, and use transcription with participants' permission. Silence unrelated audio while listening.

Requires macOS 26 or later.
